topic: Theory: Dorry and Brogy's hundred-year Little Garden duel foreshadows that only each other can stop them after Imu's Domi Reversi
title: Dorry And Brogy's Hundred Year Duel Was Foreshadowing
description: Dorry and Brogy fought to a draw for a hundred years at Little Garden. Here's my theory on why Oda turned both of them with Domi Reversi. Who wins that rematch?
comment: Dorry and Brogy: do they snap out of it by fighting each other, or does someone else free them?

lines.text: Dorry and Brogy fought for a hundred years, and Oda never told us why that matters.

shot.fallback: two giant warriors dueling on a volcanic island

lines.text: I think Elbaf is where it finally pays off.

shot.fallback: giant warrior captains on a snowy island

lines.text: At Little Garden, the two giants fought every time the volcano erupted.

shot.fallback: giants clashing as a volcano erupts

lines.text: It started over a Sea King, and tens of thousands of duels all ended in a draw.

shot.fallback: two giants arguing over a dead sea monster

lines.text: So here's the setup: these two are each other's perfect equal.

shot.fallback: two giants of equal strength facing off

lines.text: Now look at Elbaf. Imu uses Domi Reversi on both of them.

shot.fallback: dark circle flipping a giant into a demon

lines.text: People say Oda just wanted a nostalgia cameo. But he didn't turn one giant. He turned both.

shot.fallback: two corrupted giants with glowing eyes

lines.text: Imu flips their personalities, but not the rivalry that built them.

shot.fallback: giant pirate captains side by side

lines.text: My theory is the only person who can stop Dorry is Brogy.

shot.fallback: two giants swinging axe and sword at each other

lines.text: A hundred years of draws becomes the one fight that finally frees them.

shot.fallback: giants dueling beneath a stormy sky

lines.text: Dorry and Brogy fought for a hundred years...

shot.fallback: two giant warriors dueling on a volcanic island
